texts.zh:
我们一个管理单元关于其他帝国未经过滤的陈述意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，通讯单元未能关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
texts.en:
One of our admin units' unfiltered statements about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications unit forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

texts.zh:

[careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective]大众对[This.GetName]的观点不可避免地下降了。
texts.en:
One of our admin drones' disparaging remarks about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications drone forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.

texts.zh:
我们一位地方官员对其他帝国的个人观点意外地广播给了该国的附属国。在一次关于超空间航道监视的艰难讨论之后，一名通信人员忘记关闭传输频道，让[careless_talk_empire.GetName]听到了随后那一连串的咒骂。

texts.en:
One of our regional administrators' personal opinions about another empire were accidentally broadcast to their subject. Following a difficult discussion about hyperlane surveillance, a communications operative forgot to close the transmission channel, allowing the [careless_talk_empire.GetName] to hear the stream of expletives that followed.

The [careless_talk_empire.GetAdjective] population's opinion of the [This.GetName] has inevitably declined.
